verdict.rationale: NetHunt's marketing pages describe trigger-based automation ('automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity'). They also cover record updates via pipeline stage changes on trigger events, automated tasks with alerts, and automatic lead routing. Every element of the story is named, but only in brief claims. Missing for 10: detailed workflow-builder documentation (available triggers, conditions, full action list), explicit evidence of creating tasks and sending notifications as workflow actions, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can build trigger-based workflows that update records, create tasks, and send notifications automatically

citations.quote: Launch automated actions based on any change in Sales CRM fields or user activity.
Adjust stages of the pipeline based on any trigger event.
Automate tasks and get alerts for key updates to stay on track.
Automatically capture and route leads to sales managers for faster follow-up.
